verdict.rationale: Pandoc documents single-invocation conversion with mid-conversion AST filters and stdin/stdout I/O, but nothing shows a native way to define a multi-step job (convert, then optimize, then deliver) or a watched workflow. Shell piping, GitHub Actions and external tools like unoconv are user-side or host-platform workarounds, and filters are an adjacent in-conversion transform rather than step chaining, so none of them earn credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can chain steps (convert, then optimize, then deliver) into one job or watched workflow
